list.title: My experiences
list.subtitle: Create, manage and share your animated greetings.

empty.title: No experiences yet

card.deleteConfirmBody: This can't be undone. The shareable link will stop working.

share.title: Share your experience
share.subtitle: Send this private link to the person you're celebrating.
share.whatsappText: I made something special for you 💛
share.qrHint: Scan to open on a phone
share.notReady: Publish this experience to get a shareable link.

create.title: Create a new experience
create.subtitle: Choose a template to begin. You can personalize everything next.
create.noTemplates: No templates available yet. Please check back soon.
create.error: Couldn't create the experience. Please try again.

details.title: Who is this for?
details.subtitle: We'll use this name throughout the experience.

content.title: Personalize each scene
content.subtitle: Edit the words and add a photo to every step. The preview updates live.
content.tokenHint: Tip: type '{recipient}' to insert their name automatically.

review.title: Ready to share?
review.subtitle: Take one last look, then publish or continue to payment.
review.compedNote: Your account includes every template, so publishing this one is free.

checkout.title: Complete your payment
checkout.subtitle: Premium experiences unlock after a quick manual review.
checkout.error: Couldn't upload your screenshot. Please try again.

steps.title: How to pay
steps.s1: Open your banking or InstaPay app.
steps.s2: Send the exact amount to the handle above.
steps.s3: Take a screenshot of the successful transfer.
steps.s4: Upload it below with the transfer reference.

form.error: Couldn't submit. Check your details and try again.
form.needScreenshot: Please upload your payment screenshot first.

order.title: Order status
order.submittedBody: Thanks! Our team is reviewing your transfer. This usually takes a short while — we'll unlock your link once it's confirmed.
order.approvedBody: Your payment was confirmed and your experience is now live.
order.rejectedBody: We couldn't verify this transfer. Please review the reason and try again.
order.pendingBody: Complete your payment to unlock this experience.
